briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.4%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Rather than forcing cash to work or holding idle, we added one high-conviction position (CIEN) that showed full multi-signal confirmation, while leaving existing holdings untouched to let stop-loss and profit targets do their job.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means only acting on a bullish signal when multiple indicators agree — like RSI in a healthy range, a MACD crossover, and price above its moving average all pointing the same way. Relying on just one signal can lead to false starts, while confluence of several reduces the odds of buying into a fakeout.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認係指要有多個技術指標同時支持先至進場，例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現金叉、股價企穩在移動平均線之上。只靠單一訊號好容易誤判，多重訊號共同確認先可以降低「假突破」嘅風險。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly lower today with no dominant catalyst, reflecting a pause after recent moves rather than a shift in sentiment. Trading stayed range-bound as investors awaited clearer directional signals. Neutral days like this typically reward selectivity over broad index-wide conviction.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅整理，納指跌0.2%，標普500跌0.4%，未見明顯利好或利淡消息主導市場，較似係近期升勢後嘅短暫喘定。成交淡靜，投資者靜候更明確嘅方向性訊號。呢類中性市況下，選股能力比追蹤大盤更為重要。

trades.reasoning: Top-scoring candidate (95) with full bullish confirmation — RSI 59.2 in the healthy 55-70 zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, and price above SMA-20 — a genuine setup rather than a forced deployment.
